idea.name: Moving tote rental and realtor gifting
idea.one_liner: Rent reusable moving totes to households and sell monthly tote gift packages to realtors, with delivery, collection and optional upsells.
idea.customer: Households moving home and local realtors gifting totes to clients.
idea.offer: Reusable totes delivered for a move, collected afterward, and offered through realtor gift credits.
idea.revenue_model: Per-rental fees, monthly realtor subscriptions and customer upsells.

key_quotes.quote: I started looking at like wholesale boxes, loosely exploring like could I do a box selling business, and found Tote Rental was a thing.
Now, we have realtors signed up on a monthly basis that pay basically a subscription to gift moving boxes to their clients for closings.
And then when they're done, we go pick them up.
When the customer redeems it, I built an upsell mechanism.

idea.name: RV rental on consignment

idea.customer: RV owners with nearby campers, plus travelers renting the units.

idea.revenue_model: Split of the nightly rental fee with the RV owner.
